program: Subsidio Nacional al Transporte Público — renovación de flota / buses cero emisión (Fondos de Apoyo Regional)
funder_institution: Ministerio de Transportes y Telecomunicaciones (MTT) — División de Transporte Público Regional (DTPR)
eligible_actor: public transport operator (fleet renewal); GORE administers
amount_note: Reformed subsidy law (Aug 2024) earmarks >=50% of regional Fondos de Apoyo Regional (FAR) to operation + fleet renewal; incentivises zero-emission buses, charging infrastructure and public bicycles. 1,028 electric buses awarded for incorporation 2026-27; 396 e-buses already operating across regional cities. Per-call amounts set by each GORE's bases.
access_pathway: intermediated (operator applies via GORE/SEREMI/DTPR platform; municipality/GORE structurally involved)
notes: Strongest city-relevant transport lever but city is not the applicant — operators apply, GORE administers. Amount per call set in GORE bases (unverified at program level). Climate: electrification of regional public transport.

program: Renueva tu Micro (Programa Especial de Renovación de Buses de Transporte Público)
amount_note: Subsidy to scrap and renew buses of regulated/registered public transport; favours lower-emission replacement. Amount varies by vehicle and process (per ChileAtiende ficha 25058).
access_pathway: intermediated (operator applies; not a city grant)
notes: Fleet-renewal subsidy; climate relevance is replacement toward cleaner vehicles (not exclusively zero-emission). Exact 2026 amounts/windows unverified — confirm on ChileAtiende ficha 25058.

program: Renueva tu Colectivo (Programa de Renovación de Taxis Colectivos)
eligible_actor: taxi colectivo operator (natural/legal person; vehicle >=4 yrs; vigente in Registro de Transporte Público)
amount_note: ~CLP 6.8M special subsidy for electric replacement; figures of ~CLP 7.7M and up to ~CLP 9M cited with scrappage (vary by region/process). Reajustado cada marzo.
notes: Clearest EV-weighted transport subsidy; eligible actor is the colectivo operator, not the municipality. EV gets the special (higher) subsidy. Verified amounts approximate — confirm current value on ChileAtiende ficha 43671.
